measurements.conditions: S1 in water; quinine sulfate reference in 0.5 M H2SO4 with adopted Phi=0.55. Five concentrations each, absorbance <0.1 at 350 nm; integrated PL-versus-absorbance slope comparison, refractive index 1.33 for each solvent. Excitation 350 nm, 1.00 cm quartz cuvette, excitation/emission slit widths 2.5 nm. Five optical concentrations do not establish five synthesis replicates. Quinine sulfate/H2SO4 are calibration materials, not recipe ingredients.
